plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Art New Media A.A. Degree (Full Time, Fall Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 02, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7278/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS, Start Term: Fall, TRANSFER PATH. Total Units 60 = 15+15+15+15 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Elective courses: any elective courses numbered 100-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. This is a broad degree with many areas of interest and this is just one possible path; there are many elective options and students are encouraged to substitute elective courses where applicable. Suggested electives by focus: illustration focus — ARTNM 324, 325, 326, 370, 372, and 373; animation focus — ARTNM 373, 405, 420, 421, 422, 423, 429, and 431; graphic design focus — ARTNM 303, 324, 328, 352, 354, 358, and 359. Scheduling: ARTNM 325, 359, 372, and 373 are offered in the fall; ARTNM 326, 370, 422, and 450 are offered in the spring; ARTNM 421 is offered in the fall of even-numbered years; ARTNM 423 is offered in the fall of odd-numbered years; ARTNM 429 is offered in the spring of even-numbered years; ARTNM 431 is offered in the spring of odd-numbered years; ARTNM 358 and 359 are offered occasionally. This degree can be completed using either the local AA/AS GE pattern or the Cal-GETC transfer GE pattern; see a counselor. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. See ASSIST.ORG for transfer requirements of the destination institution. Students with a cumulative GPA of 3.2 or better who complete 15 or more units of Honors coursework earn an Honors Transfer Certificate.
